cli.bootstrap.title: first administrator created

cli.command.helpHint: Use "{{.Command}}" for more information about a command.

cli.users.short: Manage the school's accounts in Kratos
cli.users.unknownRole: Unknown role {{.Role}}; choose admin or planner
config.documentsNeedKeys: a document bucket needs storage.documents.access_key and secret_key, or GOPTIVUM_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY and GOPTIVUM_STORAGE_SECRET_KEY
config.identityNeedsAdminURL: identity.public_url is set, so identity.admin_url is required
config.identityURLsCollide: identity.public_url and identity.admin_url are the same address; the public one is proxied and the admin one must never be reachable
config.postgresNeedsDSN: a postgres database needs storage.database.dsn or GOPTIVUM_DATABASE_URL
error.badRequest: the request could not be read
error.internal: the server failed unexpectedly; the cause is in its log
error.requestTooLarge: this is larger than the server accepts
error.unavailable: the server cannot do this right now; try again in a moment
error.validation: some of what was sent cannot be used
export.noTimetable: this version has no timetable to export
gpf.identityRequired: this file needs a key this server does not have
gpf.malformed: this file is damaged and cannot be read
gpf.notAFile: this is not a Goptivum Project File
gpf.unsupportedAlgorithm: this file needs something this version of Goptivum does not understand
gpf.unsupportedVersion: this file was written by a newer version of Goptivum (format {{.Found}}, and this one reads up to {{.Known}})
gpf.wrongPassword: that password does not open this file
gpf.wrongRealm: this file belongs to {{.File}} and you are signed in to {{.Local}}
import.unsupportedFormat: this is not a timetable file this server can read
logs.auditFailed: a change was not written to the audit trail
logs.backupsTrimmed: older versions beyond the backups cap removed
logs.bootstrapFailed: could not create the first administrator
logs.checkCountsDrift: the check's counts differ from the node's verdict
logs.demoSchoolEnabled: the demo school route is on; this is a development setting
logs.demoSchoolFailed: no node gave the demo school
logs.escrowDisabled: no escrow passphrase configured, so no school key is held
logs.exportFailed: an export could not be built
logs.noIdentityProvider: no identity provider configured, serving discovery and health only
logs.objectSweepFailed: could not delete stored documents that no version names
logs.objectsSwept: deleted stored documents that no version names any more
logs.orphanedJobsClosed: closed solves left open by a previous run
logs.ownersUnread: the owners' names could not be read
logs.passwordRulesUnreadable: the password rules could not be read from the Kratos configuration
logs.ruleCatalogueFailed: no node listed the solver's rules
logs.trashPurgeFailed: could not remove old items from Trash
logs.trashPurged: removed what outlived its time in Trash
logs.userSessionsEnded: an account was signed out everywhere
node.clientTooOld: the solver node needs a newer version of this server
node.fingerprintMismatch: the machine at this address is not the expected solver node; pair the node again with a new link
node.linkSpent: the node refused this pairing link: it has expired, was already used or was never issued; ask the node's operator for a new one
node.notALink: this is not a pairing link; a pairing link starts with arrango://
node.notPaired: the solver node no longer accepts this server; pair it again
node.outdated: the solver node needs an update before it can do this ({{.Capability}})
node.pairingFailed: pairing with the solver node failed
node.solvesAboveCeiling: this node's limit on solves at once for this server: {{.Ceiling}}
node.unreachable: the solver node did not answer
node.workersAboveCeiling: this node's limit on workers per solve for this server: {{.Ceiling}}
plans.notYours: only this plan's owner can change it
plans.versionConflict: somebody saved first: this plan is at version {{.Current}} and your change was made against version {{.Parent}}
rules.profileNotYours: only the account that created this profile or an administrator can change it
rules.waitingForSolver: the rule list is waiting for the solver
solve.incompleteBaseline: {{.Unplaced}} of {{.Lessons}} lessons have no place in the current timetable, so there is nothing to improve on; place them first, or solve from scratch
solve.infeasible: this school cannot be scheduled as it stands
solve.limitTooLong: the requested solve time exceeds the node limit of {{.max_seconds}} seconds
solve.modelInvalid: this plan cannot be solved as it stands: the node found {{.Count}} problem(s) that make a valid timetable impossible
solve.noScheduleInTime: no timetable was found within the time limit
solve.nodeError: the solver node failed or stopped answering
solve.nodeUnavailable: no solver node can take this right now
solve.preflightFailed: the solver refused the inputs before searching
solve.resultNotStored: a timetable was found, but the server could not store it
solve.serverRestarted: the server stopped while this solve was running
users.alreadyExists: an account already signs in with this username or email
users.lastAdmin: the school would have no enabled administrator left
